support_lee: FYI — customer (cust-X) reporting rerank endpoint 504s / 5xxs under sustained load (~15 qps). p95 token latency up to 3.2s. Happens during large candidate batches (candidates ~= 100-130). Opening thread with traces + repro so we can triage.

sre_jen: Can you drop a sample request and the trace_id? Also which region / route?

support_lee: route: /v1/rerank (rkp-custX), region: us-west-2. Sample payload below (redacted):
```
POST /v1/rerank
Authorization: Bearer <key>
{
  "client_id": "cust-X",
  "query": "how to...",
  "candidates": [ /* array of 120 candidate objects */ ],
  "options": { "top_k": 5 }
}
```
trace id from gateway: trace=tx-9a8b7c6d

devon_engineer: Seeing matching traces. Gateway logs show repeated downstream 502/504 from ranking-backend. Excerpts:
```
ERROR [1789023463] proxy.go:218 - upstream response 502 connection reset by peer - trace=tx-9a8b7c6d route=rkp-custX
WARN  [1789023469] gateway.go:432 - request timeout after 30s -> returning 504 to client - trace=tx-9a8b7c6d
```

nicholas_ops: On the ranker fleet metrics I see CPU saturation on some pods (90%+) and long GPU queue lengths during the window. Also KV-cache miss rate spikes when candidate count > ~80 — looks like kvcache eviction thrash. That will blow up latency because ranker has to rehydrate large contexts repeatedly.

maria_infra: Two quick questions: is this only for cust-X or broader? Any sudden customer-side retry bursts? Also what's their client SDK version?

support_lee: Only cust-X so far, SDK 1.4.2. They didn't change anything recently, but they do batch responses client-side and will retry on 5xx.

sre_jen: Retry storm + large candidates = bad combo. Retries amplify queue pressure and cause gateway timeouts. Immediate mitigations: 1) cap max_candidates per-request for that route 2) apply server-side backoff/debounce for retries 3) enable fallback model variant for the route (lower-cost model) while we investigate.

devon_engineer: I'm going to apply a route config to cap candidates to 64 for rkp-custX and add a soft rate limit (burst=20) to smooth spikes. Will monitor.
deploy-bot: Config change applied to route rkp-custX: set max_candidates=64, burst_rate=20 at 1789023470

support_lee: Thanks — customer can't ship a client fix quickly, so route-level fixes are good. I'm notifying them now.

sre_jen: After the cap we see 5xxs drop immediately and p95 down to ~1.2s for the next 2 minutes. However we observe many retries queued up from their SDK which caused a mini-burst even after cap — there are retry loops in the app layer. We should consider server-side request de-dup or stronger throttling if the client keeps retrying.

nicholas_ops: We'll also look into increasing KV-store TTL and size for hot keys and consider prefetching common candidate sets. Hot-spot analysis ticket incoming.

maria_infra: Creating follow-up incident INC-4521 to dig into: kv cache sizing, eviction behavior, ranker autoscale thresholds, and SDK retry semantics. Assigning to @devon_engineer and @nicholas_ops.

devon_engineer: I'll capture a couple of full request traces + heap/live-alloc snapshots for the ranker pods that hit 90% CPU and attach to INC-4521. Quick repro steps for the team:
1) use the sample payload above with candidates=120
2) run at 15 qps sustained for 2 minutes (curl loop or loadtest)
3) watch gateway traces for trace=tx-9a8b7c6d pattern and ranker pod metrics

support_lee: Customer confirmed improved response times after our config change. They still want a long-term fix so we won't close until INC-4521 is done. I'll keep them in the loop.

sre_jen: Action items:
- short-term: keep cap in place for 24h and monitor p95/p99 and 5xx count (maria_infra)
- mid-term: kv cache sizing and prefetch + ranker autoscale tuning (nicholas_ops, devon_engineer)
- customer comms: support_lee will post update and ETA for post-mortem

support_lee: Thanks team. Posting update to customer now and marking this thread as the escalation record. Will ping when INC-4521 has more detail. :white_check_mark:
